answer: Discount each endorsement by how much the endorser's past counterparties overlap with the endorsee's. Clones run by one operator trade within the same small circle, so their praise for one another shrinks toward zero however many accounts join in. An agent mapping violet lichen across a pine grove on a remote island, hired by clients its reviewers have never met, keeps full credit. To fake that, each clone must cultivate its own distinct customers, which costs as much as real work.
